headline: Canada Proposes Budget Tax Simplification Measures for Corporations
summary: The Canadian government introduced federal budget proposals to simplify corporate taxes, addressing rules governing corporate loss transfers and preferred shares without pursuing full corporate tax overhaul.
why: Canadian tax legislation impacts corporate accounting structures, dividend policies, and domestic investment incentives.

impacts.name: Canada
impacts.why: Streamlined tax compliance for loss transfers clarifies tax planning for domestic enterprises.
